name: 킹크랩
wear: Coral-red and warm ivory armor: six slender shell-spike accents become a small crown-like hair ornament; crab shell curves become shoulder and hip plate contours; the large left claw becomes a broad rounded LEFT forearm guard around a fully separate normal human hand, the right guard stays slimmer. Keep both human hands with five fingers; no pincers or carried claws.
scene: On a deserted salt-white coastal breakwater at sunrise, balanced upright card stance, face toward camera, both empty open hands separated from torso, complete boots visible.
casual: At an empty art-deco ocean-liner cabaret stage before an evening performance, standing in contrapposto and presenting both open hands at hip height; coral velvet curtains, ivory spotlight and brass floor trim.

Original adult nautical revue costume: opaque ivory halter-neck fitted bodice with coral curved seams, bare shoulders and a secure waist cutout, coral high-waisted asymmetric short skirt over opaque shorts, tall ivory boots and small crown-shaped hair clip.

In a bright coastal sculpture studio at noon, side profile leaning over a waist-high bench to smooth the rim of a large unfired ceramic bowl; both complete hands visible at opposite sides of its rim, kiln and clay shelves behind.
Coral sleeveless square-neck crop top with opaque lining, ivory wide-leg linen trousers below crop, short waist apron, bare arms shoulders and midriff, tiny shell stud earrings.

In a deserted windswept dune flower reserve after late afternoon rain, walking toward a flowering patch while looking at a butterfly outside the frame, both open hands lifted slightly for balance; sand path and pale beach grass.
Ivory sleeveless utility romper with secure front zip, short legs, coral sash and open short linen vest, bare arms shoulders legs and small side waist openings; tiny crown pendant.
